NOCTIS_WARP_STRIKE.title: Warp Strike
NOCTIS_WARP_STRIKE.description: This card is treated as a [gold]Warp Strike[/gold].
NOCTIS_ROYAL_ARMS.title: Royal Arms
NOCTIS_ROYAL_ARMS.description: Powerful cards that cost HP. Gain 6 [gold]Armiger[/gold] when played. They gain additional effects while [gold]Armiger[/gold] or [gold]Armiger Unleashed[/gold] is active.
NOCTIS_ARMIGER.title: Armiger
NOCTIS_ARMIGER.description:
At 100, enter [gold]Armiger[/gold] form for 4 turns. 

Gain 4 [gold]Armiger[/gold] from attacks. 
Gain 5 [gold]Armiger[/gold] at the start of your turn. 

During [gold]Armiger[/gold], [gold]Warp Strike[/gold] deals 4 additional damage and 
[gold]Royal Arms[/gold] gain additional effects and no longer cost HP.
